scope: Complete release CLI encryption copies; performance evidence only, no native Access comparison
path_sanitization: Repository absolute prefix removed; input bytes and private paths are not distributed
baseline_provenance: Retained previous serial CLI binary; exact source commit was not frozen, so binary SHA-256 is authoritative
initial_provenance: Built working-tree production state later committed by 46e193c3; exact build revision is not reproducibly pinned
controls: No Cargo builds/tests/rendering during cohorts. Final cohort overlapped packaging metadata audit and generation traversing Cargo metadata, six platform dependency trees and license files; one generation took approximately 30-40 seconds followed by a second generation. OS background activity, caches and thermals uncontrolled; final cohort is not an idle-machine experiment
